cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import re
PARSE_RE = re.compile(r'''({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})''')

# Test various edge cases
test_cases = [
    '{foo}',          # valid
    '{foo',           # invalid - no closing brace
    'foo}',           # invalid - unmatched closing brace
    '{foo:bar}',      # valid
    '{foo:bar',       # invalid
    '{{',             # escaped open brace
    '}}',             # escaped close brace
    '{foo}}',         # valid field followed by escaped brace
    '{{foo}',         # this would match {{ then foo}... wait no
]

for tc in test_cases:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(tc)
    print(f'{tc!r:25} -> {parts}')
"
